name: Peak Hour Payment Switch
tagline: Keep the switch stable while demand and provider health move underneath it.
narrative: It is Friday afternoon and YamusaPay is receiving a sustained mixed-traffic surge. Cheap capacity is limited, the low-cost rail develops a latency and reliability incident, the premium rail experiences a short outage, and urgent payroll payments share the queue with low-value consumer traffic. Routing changes future capacity: every accepted payment remains in flight until its provider finishes. A weak policy creates a congestion cascade even when every provider began online.
objective: Maximize completed throughput while controlling timeouts, priority misses, overload rejections, failed attempts, queue growth, and total operating score.
learningObjective: Design an adaptive load-aware policy whose routing choices account for their future effect on provider capacity and queue pressure.
intelligenceExplanation: There is no starter answer. The policy must distinguish cheap flexible traffic from urgent, high-value, payroll, and international work. Holding can be correct when capacity will recover, but unconditional holding causes expiry. Hardcoding one provider fails during the incident schedule and hidden identity swaps.
hint: Treat deadlineRemaining and capacityRemaining as scarce resources. Send urgent traffic to the fastest eligible healthy route; distribute flexible traffic by expected cost and congestion.
hints: Create early branches for near-deadline, priority, payroll, and high-value traffic.
For flexible traffic, compare eligible routes using expected cost, health score, current latency, and remaining capacity.
After a failed attempt, prefer an eligible provider other than lastProviderA/B/C; retry only while deadline budget remains.
brief: Stabilize a live peak-hour switch and pass eight hidden load, outage, recovery, and traffic-surge scenarios.
context: Provider latency rises with in-flight load, capacity is finite, failed attempts can return for retry, and transaction deadlines continue counting down.

steps.label: Segment traffic by urgency, value, and transaction type
Route using live capacity, congestion, latency, reliability, and cost
Handle retryable failures without repeating a broken route
Finish the visible surge with at most two timeouts
Submit the unchanged policy against the peak-hour hidden suite

objectives.label: Allow no more than two timeouts
Allow no more than one urgent-payment failure
Keep the visible penalty score below 100

rubric: Outage, recovery, capacity, and retry correctness: 25%

goals.description: Keep mixed payment traffic flowing safely under peak load.

states.description: Evaluate the live switch once per decision tick.

functions.description: Attempt the current payment through Provider A.
Attempt the current payment through Provider B.
Attempt the current payment through Provider C.
Wait one tick while provider work and deadlines advance.
